SEARCH
Package io.github.janglada.orkit.routing

Interface DistanceSource

All Known Implementing Classes:
DistanceSource.Haversine, DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrices, DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrix
public sealed interface DistanceSource permits DistanceSource.Haversine, DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrix, DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrices
Source for inter-node distances (in meters) and, optionally, travel times (in minutes). Create via the static factory methods.

Matrix layout: rows/columns 0..d-1 are the depots in declaration order, followed by the stops in declaration order.
